description: Name screening against the US OFAC SDN list (with aliases, sanctions programs, type and addresses, via the US Consolidated Screening List API) and the UN Security Council consolidated list, returning matching entries. Optional fuzzy matching for the SDN part. It does NOT screen crypto addresses and does NOT check the EU list. A match is a lead for a human reviewer, not a legal decision. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

fuzzy.description: true for fuzzy SDN name matching (default false)

name.description: Person or company name, 3 to 100 characters
